description: A script for generating documentation for plugins based on changed source files, JSON outputs, and headers within a software project. It automates validation of JSON changes, determines which plugins need documentation updates, and runs external scripts to generate markdown documentation accordingly.

methods.name: get_plugin_from_path(file_path)
methods.description: Extracts the plugin name from a given file path based on predefined directory structures.

methods.name: validate_json_changes(changed_files)
methods.description: Validates that JSON changes in 'apis/' have corresponding output files in 'tools/md_generator/json/'.

methods.name: get_plugins_to_process(changed_files)
methods.description: Identifies which plugins need documentation regeneration based on changed files.

methods.name: generate_docs_for_plugin(plugin_name, file_types, logfile=None)
methods.description: Orchestrates the documentation generation process for a specific plugin, including header and JSON sources.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Post-processes generated markdown files to clean or adjust content.

methods.name: update_sidebar()
methods.description: Updates the documentation sidebar after generation.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point: parses arguments, validates changes, orchestrates documentation generation, and updates the documentation structure.
